## v0.5.1

https://github.com/merwanroudane/tsseffect/releases/new?tag=v0.5.1&title=v0.5.1%20-%20Fix%20the%20README%20images%20on%20PyPI&body=Fixes%20the%20README%20images%20on%20the%20PyPI%20project%20page.%20%2A%2ANo%20change%20to%20the%20library%20itself%2A%2A%20%E2%80%94%20if%20you%20are%20on%200.5.0%20there%20is%20nothing%20here%20you%20need.%0A%0AEvery%20image%20in%20the%20README%20was%20referenced%20by%20a%20path%20relative%20to%20the%20repository.%20GitHub%20resolves%20those%3B%20PyPI%20does%20not%2C%20so%20the%20banner%20and%20all%20four%20figures%20were%20broken%20on%20the%20project%20page%2C%20which%20is%20the%20first%20thing%20most%20people%20see.%0A%0A%23%23%23%20Fixed%0A-%20All%20README%20image%20paths%20are%20absolute.%20Verified%20against%20the%20built%20metadata%3A%20nine%20image%20sources%2C%20none%20relative.%0A%0A%23%23%23%20Changed%0A-%20The%20README%20banner%20is%20a%20PNG%20rather%20than%20the%20SVG%2C%20rendered%20by%20%60examples/make_banner.py%60.%20PyPI%20rewrites%20README%20images%20through%20its%20own%20proxy%20and%20sanitizes%20the%20HTML%2C%20and%20a%20raster%20is%20the%20one%20format%20certain%20to%20survive%20that.%20The%20SVG%20is%20kept%20and%20is%20what%20the%20documentation%20site%20uses%2C%20where%20it%20stays%20crisp%20at%20any%20zoom.%0A-%20The%20changelog%27s%200.4.2%20entry%20is%20gone.%20That%20version%20was%20never%20released%3B%20the%20sdist%20fix%20it%20described%20shipped%20as%20part%20of%200.5.0.%0A%0A%2A%2AInstall%3A%2A%2A%20%60pip%20install%20--upgrade%20tseffects%60%0A


## v0.5.0

https://github.com/merwanroudane/tsseffect/releases/new?tag=v0.5.0&title=v0.5.0%20-%20Documentation%20site%2C%20real-data%20example%2C%20journal%20tables&body=The%20documentation%20site%2C%20a%20complete%20worked%20example%20on%20real%20data%2C%20and%20journal-quality%20tables.%0A%0A%23%23%23%20The%20example%20makes%20the%20case%20better%20than%20any%20toy%20data%20could%0A%0AWorking%20through%20the%20Cavari%20%282019%29%20presidential%20approval%20series%20shipped%20with%20the%20package%3A%20the%20two%20consumer-sentiment%20coefficients%20almost%20cancel%20%E2%80%94%20%2A%2A%2B0.3118%20and%20%E2%88%920.2584%2C%20a%20net%20%2B0.0534%2A%2A%20%E2%80%94%20so%20the%20coefficient%20table%20says%20sentiment%20hardly%20matters.%0A%0AThe%20step%20response%20says%20the%20effect%20is%20%2A%2A%2B0.3307%2A%2A%2C%20six%20times%20that%2C%20significant%20at%201%25%20through%20five%20quarters%2C%20and%20no%20longer%20distinguishable%20from%20zero%20in%20the%20long%20run.%20None%20of%20those%20three%20facts%20is%20readable%20off%20the%20coefficients.%0A%0AThe%20interaction%20with%20economic%20salience%20turns%20out%20to%20govern%20the%20%2A%2Aspeed%2A%2A%20of%20the%20response%20rather%20than%20its%20destination%3A%20at%20high%20salience%20approval%20makes%20its%20whole%20move%20immediately%2C%20at%20low%20salience%20it%20takes%20about%20five%20years%20to%20reach%20essentially%20the%20same%20place.%0A%0A%23%23%23%20Added%0A-%20%60EffectResult.summary%28%29%60%20%E2%80%94%20an%20aligned%20table%20with%20a%20model%20and%20sample%20block%2C%20stars%20at%201/5/10%20per%20cent%2C%20the%20long%20run%20set%20apart%20under%20its%20own%20rule%2C%20and%20a%20footer%20naming%20the%20variance%20estimator.%20Plus%20%60as_latex%28%29%60%20%28booktabs%2C%20SEs%20in%20parentheses%2C%20a%20notes%20block%29%2C%20%60as_markdown%28%29%60%20and%20%60as_html%28%29%60%2C%20all%20built%20from%20one%20frame%20so%20they%20cannot%20disagree.%0A-%20%60EffectResult.to_frame%28%29%60%20%E2%80%94%20estimates%20with%20z%20statistics%2C%20two-sided%20normal%20p-values%20and%20significance%20markers.%0A-%20The%20Parula%20colour%20family%2C%20with%20the%20same%20names%20and%20stops%20as%20the%20R%20packages%3A%20%60parula_colors%60%2C%20%60parula_cmap%60%2C%20%60matlab_jet_colors%60%2C%20%60turbo_colors%60%2C%20%60bluered_colors%60%2C%20%60sinha_colors%60%2C%20%60resolve_colorscale%60%2C%20%60sequential_cmap%60%2C%20%60diverging_cmap%60.%0A-%20%60examples/approval_empirical.py%60%2C%20the%20single%20source%20for%20every%20figure%20in%20the%20README%20and%20on%20the%20documentation%20site.%0A-%20A%20GitHub%20Pages%20site%20under%20%60docs/%60%3A%20theory%20with%20KaTeX%20and%20a%20step-to-equation%20map%2C%20a%20full%20API%20reference%2C%20the%20real-data%20application%2C%20how%20to%20read%20the%20output%2C%20and%20the%20validation%20evidence.%0A-%20%60CITATION.cff%60%2C%20a%20changelog%2C%20and%20CI%20on%20Python%203.9%20through%203.13.%0A%0A%23%23%23%20Fixed%0A-%20The%20%60%22Baseline%22%60%20and%20%60%220%22%60%20tick%20labels%20overlapped%20on%20fitted-value%20plots.%0A-%20The%20source%20distribution%20shipped%20the%20tests%20without%20their%20%60conftest.py%60%2C%20so%20they%20could%20not%20be%20run.%0A%0A%23%23%23%20Validation%0AStill%20%2A%2A193/193%2A%2A%20against%20the%20R%20package%20at%20rtol%201e-9.%20The%20GECM%20path%20reproduces%20the%20isomorphic%20ADL%20fit%20to%20%2A%2A2.31e-14%2A%2A%20on%20the%20approval%20data.%0A


## v0.4.1

https://github.com/merwanroudane/tsseffect/releases/new?tag=v0.4.1&title=v0.4.1%20-%20First%20release&body=First%20release%3A%20a%20Python%20port%20of%20the%20R%20package%20%5Btseffects%200.4.1%5D%28https%3A//cran.r-project.org/package%3Dtseffects%29%20by%20Soren%20Jordan%2C%20Garrett%20N.%20Vande%20Kamp%20and%20Reshi%20Rajan%2C%20under%20the%20same%20GPL%20%28%E2%89%A5%202%29.%0A%0AAutoregressive%20distributed%20lag%20models%20are%20easy%20to%20estimate.%20Getting%20dynamic%20inferences%20back%20out%20of%20them%20is%20not%3A%20the%20coefficients%20alone%20do%20not%20tell%20you%20how%20a%20shock%20to%20x%20moves%20y%20three%20periods%20later%2C%20nor%20what%20happens%20when%20the%20shock%20is%20permanent%20rather%20than%20transitory%2C%20nor%20what%20happens%20when%20the%20model%20was%20estimated%20in%20differences%20but%20you%20want%20the%20answer%20in%20levels.%0A%0A%23%23%23%20Added%0A-%20%60gdrf_adl%60%20/%20%60adl_effects%60%20%E2%80%94%20dynamic%20effects%20from%20an%20ADL%20model.%0A-%20%60gdrf_gecm%60%20/%20%60gecm_effects%60%20%E2%80%94%20the%20same%20from%20a%20Generalized%20Error-Correction%20Model%2C%20via%20the%20exact%20ADL%20translation.%0A-%20%60interact_adl%60%20%E2%80%94%20conditional%20effects%20from%20a%20multiplicative%20interaction%2C%20as%20lines%20over%20periods%2C%20lines%20over%20the%20moderator%2C%20or%20a%20surface.%0A-%20The%20symbolic%20layer%20as%20public%20API%3A%20%60pulse_calculator%60%2C%20%60general_calculator%60%2C%20%60convolution_calculator%60%2C%20%60gecm_to_adl%60%2C%20%60yhat_calculator%60%2C%20%60shock_weights%60%2C%20%60combine_interaction_terms%60.%0A-%20%60delta_method%60%2C%20%60DeltaFn%60%20and%20%60BatchDelta%60%20for%20inference%2C%20and%20%60vcov_hc%60%20for%20the%20full%20%60sandwich%3A%3AvcovHC%60%20family%20%E2%80%94%20%60const%60%20and%20%60HC0%60%20through%20%60HC5%60%2C%20where%20%60statsmodels%60%20ships%20only%20%60HC0%60%E2%80%93%60HC3%60.%0A-%20Plots%20in%20matplotlib%2C%20and%20the%20two%20datasets%20from%20the%20R%20package.%0A%0A%23%23%23%20Validation%0A%2A%2A193/193%2A%2A%20numerical%20checks%20against%20the%20R%20package%20at%20a%20relative%20tolerance%20of%201e-9%2C%20across%2029%20specifications.%20Independently%20of%20R%2C%20the%20GECM%20path%20reproduces%20the%20isomorphic%20ADL%20fit%20to%20%2A%2A1.3e-15%2A%2A.%0A
